title: Malachi 1: chapter overview
paragraphs: They are careless in God's institutions.

outline.text: They are careless in God's institutions.

context: Malachi was the last of the prophets, and is supposed to have prophesied B.C. 420.
attribution: Matthew Henry, Concise Commentary (public domain). Historical Protestant interpretation; other traditions may read these passages differently.
